282276770.description:
Mineral and Polished Stone Specimen Collection
Lot of 11 Pieces
Natural Crystals, Polished Minerals, Geode, and 1975 Commemorative Display
A diverse 11-piece mineral and polished stone collection weighing 10.91 pounds in total. The lot features natural crystalline specimens, shaped and polished display pieces, and an Italian commemorative encased rock mount from 1975.
Items Included:
Natural purple amethyst crystal cluster specimen
Hollow quartz crystal geode half with sparkling druzy interior
Dark amber-brown heat-treated amethyst / citrine crystal cluster
Smoky quartz polished hexagonal point / obelisk
Clear quartz polished hexagonal point / obelisk
Polished pink and cream stone sphere with top indentation
Four polished stone eggs including septarian, honey calcite, banded onyx, and pale agate
Encased Monte Bondone 1975 Sport Hotel commemorative mineral specimen with silver-tone floral accent in acrylic case
Condition:
Obelisks show natural imperfections and surface chips. All specimens feature natural geological variations, pitting, and light surface scratches. Acrylic display case shows light surface scuffing and handling wear consistent with age.
